text: {"assertions":["A bug in platform/config/loader.py caused wrong environment configuration affecting tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys.","The root cause was a listener that was registered but never removed during teardown.","The bug manifested as a production endpoint being accessed from a staging process.","The fix removed the listener on teardown and added a test assertion to prevent regression.","PR #4072 on branch fix/wrong-environment-1 implements the fix.","The bug could be reproduced by booting the service with an unset profile variable.","Fixing this bug reclaimed 53 GB of blob storage."]}
